entries.17a8083643aca895: This business manufactures and sells synthetic resin paints. Centered on metal and building material paints, the company and its subsidiaries in China, the Philippines and Vietnam manufacture, and sales are made through a Thai sales subsidiary and exclusive agents. The business also purchases and sells paint-related products. In July 2024, the group acquired the interior building material paint sales business from DIC Group. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥14,295 million, which is the core of the group's revenue.

entries.b5236c7c07a6a859: This business recovers and distills used solvents to produce and sell recycled solvents. Tomoe Kogyo Co., Ltd., Sanmaru Kagaku Co., Ltd. and Ai-Shii Sangyo Co., Ltd. handle manufacturing, and Tomoe Kogyo and Sanmaru Kagaku also collect, transport and dispose of industrial waste. Sanmaru Kagaku joined the group in June 2025. External sales in the fiscal year ended October 2025 were ¥5,494 million.
entries.bafb828d5fed1298: Under its mission, “to create new value through unique ideas,” it aims to develop into a “renovation and innovation company for all surfaces” as its 2030 vision.
